current-reference.label: Slack + Atlassian + Notion + GitHub (direct)
current-reference.preflight_prompt: Use each of the four direct MCP servers—Slack, Atlassian, Notion, and GitHub—for one harmless read-only lookup or search. Return one sentence confirming which servers retrieved data.

minimal.label: Atlassian + Slack (direct)
minimal.preflight_prompt: Use Atlassian MCP for one harmless read-only lookup, then Slack MCP for one harmless read-only search. Return one sentence confirming both retrievals worked.
